title: The whole cutter
caption: The Bastion from the starboard bow: sensor bow and docking collar, the dorsal coilgun, the armored drum between its two fixed collars, and the boat bay, water tanks and twin torches aft.

title: Armored drum
caption: The spin-gravity drum close up: spaced rim plates on hoop frames, a few small viewports, and the fixed collars with their motor-generators and the high-gain antenna.

title: Dorsal coilgun
caption: The dorsal turret on its barbette, its 24 m barrel a stack of drive coils in a stringer cage, with the capacitor banks beside it and the cabin radiators spread to both sides.

title: Under thrust
caption: Both fusion torches lit, seen from the stern quarter: the magnetic nozzles, the shadow shield, and the stepped hot radiators glowing at full power.
